definition_zh: （学校）财务主管；（英国大学）司库；学费奖学金领取者
definition_en: the officer in charge of money at a school or college; also a student holding a bursary
core_image: 账房里管钱袋的先生，钥匙串在腰间叮当作响
scene: 学院账房里，管钱的先生正核对一叠账单。The bursar approved the budget for the new library.
sceneCN: 这里 bursar 是「财务主管、司库」（第 1 个义项：负责学校钱账的职员）；句意是这位司库批准了新图书馆的预算。

pos.zh: 领取助学金（奖学金）的学生

derivatives.zh: 由 bursar 加 -y 构成，义为「助学金；奖学金」
同源拉丁词，本义「钱袋」，医学中指「滑囊」
由 re- 加同源词根构成，义为「偿还，报销」

senses.title: The money officer of a school or college
senses.definition: the official responsible for the finances and accounts of a school, college or similar institution
senses.definitionCN: 负责学校、学院等机构财务与账目的职员
senses.example: The bursar signed off every payment the college made.
senses.exampleCN: 学院的每笔付款都由司库签字核准。
senses.why: The word comes from the purse that held the money, and the officer keeps that purse.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自装钱的钱袋，主管就是守住钱袋的人。

senses.title: A student who holds a bursary
senses.definition: a student whose studies are paid for by a grant or scholarship, especially at a British school
senses.definitionCN: 由补助金或奖学金资助学业的学生，多见于英国学校
senses.example: He entered the school as a bursar with his fees fully paid.
senses.exampleCN: 他以奖学金生的身份入学，学费全免。
senses.why: The purse that pays the institution also pays the student, so the funded learner takes the purse's name.
senses.whyCN: 钱袋既供机构开销，也资助学生，受助者便以钱袋为名。

senses.title: A manager of a monastery's temporal affairs
senses.definition: in some religious houses, the monk appointed to manage property and money matters
senses.definitionCN: 在某些修会中受命管理财产与钱财事务的修士
senses.example: The old bursar kept the abbey's ledgers in careful order.
senses.exampleCN: 老管事把修道院的账簿整理得井井有条。
senses.why: Monasteries ran large estates, so they needed a purse-keeper of their own.
senses.whyCN: 修道院经营大量产业，同样需要一位管钱袋的人。

intro.en: Bursar goes back to a Late Latin word for a bag or purse, the holder of money.
intro.cn: bursar 源自后期拉丁语中指袋子、钱袋的词，即掌管钱财之人。

items.en: bursa meant a bag made of hide, later a purse of money.
items.cn: 后期拉丁语 bursa 指皮革做的袋子，后指钱袋。

items.en: bursarius named the officer who kept the purse of an institution.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 bursarius 指为机构掌管钱袋的职员。

items.en: boussiere and bourser carried the purse sense into French.
items.cn: 古法语 boussiere、bourser 把钱袋义带入法语。

items.en: bursar entered English for the finance officer of a college, then for a funded student.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪 bursar 进入英语，先指学院财务官，后指受助学生。

items.en: The academic senses survive, while the related bursary names the grant itself.
items.cn: 如今学校义项保留，同族的 bursary 指助学金本身。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the purse root; the near-meaning group lists other money-handling roles.
note.cn: 形近组同出「钱袋」词根；近义组是其他管钱的角色。

entries.definition: a grant of money for a student
entries.definitionCN: 助学金，bursar 的同族名词

entries.definition: a fluid-filled sac in the body, originally a purse
entries.definitionCN: 滑囊，本义钱袋，词源同源

entries.definition: to pay money out from a fund
entries.definitionCN: 支出，支付，同出钱袋词根
偿还，报销，字面义「再装入钱袋」

entries.definition: a person who manages an organisation's money
entries.definitionCN: 司库，管理组织财务的人

entries.definition: an officer who manages an estate for its owner
a college officer keeping official records
entries.definitionCN: 注册主任，管理学籍档案的职员

normalIntro.en: Follow the purse: whoever holds it, in the office or in class, is the bursar.
normalIntro.cn: 盯住钱袋：无论在账房还是在课堂，握钱袋者即 bursar。

normal.en: The root bursa means purse, the bag of money.
normal.cn: 词根 bursa 意为钱袋，装钱的袋子。

normal.en: Disburse means to let money out of the purse.
normal.cn: disburse 指把钱从钱袋里发放出去。

normal.en: Reimburse literally means to fill the purse again.
normal.cn: reimburse 字面义是「重新装满钱袋」，即偿还。

normal.en: Bursary is the purse given to a funded student.
normal.cn: bursary 是发给受助学生的那只钱袋。

normal.en: In anatomy bursa kept the bag meaning as a sac.
normal.cn: 解剖学里 bursa 保留「袋」义，指滑囊。

abstract.en: Hear the jangle of keys on a purse-laden belt.
abstract.cn: 听腰间挂着钱袋的钥匙串叮当作响。

abstract.en: See the ledger open and the seal pressed on each page.
abstract.cn: 看账簿翻开，每页都盖了印。

abstract.en: Picture a scholar whose fees arrive in a small purse.
abstract.cn: 想象一名学生，他的学费装在一只小钱袋里送来。

examples.en: The bursar explained the fee increase to the parents.
examples.cn: 财务主管向家长们解释了涨费的原因。

examples.en: She won a place at the school as a bursar.
examples.cn: 她以奖学金生的身份获得了这所学校的名额。

examples.en: Disbursements from the fund are authorised by the bursar.
examples.cn: 基金支出均由财务主管核准。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拨色儿」——司库管钱，要给各院系「拨」款，还得「审」账目，颜色分明的账本一拨一审。

root: bursar 源自后期拉丁语 bursa「皮袋，钱袋」，中世纪拉丁语 bursarius 指为机构管钱袋的职员；同族词 disburse（支出）、reimburse（偿还，字面「再入袋」）、bursary（助学金）都围着这只钱袋展开。

sensesIntro.en: From a Latin purse comes the keeper of a college's money, the student paid from that purse, and the old monastery's steward.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一只拉丁钱袋长出三个义项：学院管钱的司库、从钱袋受助的学生，以及旧时修道院的庶务管事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a purse of money kept behind the office door.
core.cn: 核心意象：账房门后守着的一只钱袋。

branches.en: the bursar's office pays the bills
the college bursar signs every cheque
branches.cn: 学院司库签署每张支票

branches.en: a bursar whose fees are fully funded
bursar and bursary, holder and grant
branches.cn: bursar 与 bursary：领钱人与那笔钱

branches.en: the monastery bursar managing the estates

intro.en: Bursar carries the Latin purse root with the agent ending, and its family all move money in or out of the bag.
intro.cn: bursar 带着拉丁「钱袋」词根加施动者词尾，其同族词都围绕钱袋进出。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin bursa, a hide bag, is the shared root of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 后期拉丁语 bursa（皮袋）是整个词族的共同词根。

items.exampleCN: 学院的司库（中世纪拉丁语）

items.meaning: to pay out of a fund
to pay back, refill the purse
a keeper of funds, parallel role
